properties.name: lavshard.enabled
properties.description: 是否启用 LavShard 自动配置.

properties.name: lavshard.integration.default-data-source
properties.description: 普通表透传和无表只读 SQL 使用的默认数据源 ID.

properties.name: lavshard.integration.default-transaction-isolation
properties.description: 逻辑连接和 Starter 托管连接池使用的默认事务隔离级别.

properties.name: lavshard.integration.managed-mapper-packages
properties.description: 由 LavShard 管理的 MyBatis Mapper 包名或完整 namespace 集合.

properties.name: lavshard.integration.ordinary-tables
properties.description: 允许保持原 SQL 并路由到默认数据源的普通表集合.

properties.name: lavshard.data-sources
properties.description: 数据源 ID 到物理数据源配置的映射；每项必须且只能选择 bean-name 或 managed 模式.

properties.name: lavshard.data-sources.*.bean-name
properties.description: 应用提供的 DataSource Bean 名称；不能与 managed 同时配置.

properties.name: lavshard.data-sources.*.managed.url
properties.description: Starter 托管物理数据源的 JDBC URL.

properties.name: lavshard.data-sources.*.managed.username
properties.description: Starter 托管物理数据源的用户名.

properties.name: lavshard.data-sources.*.managed.password
properties.description: Starter 托管物理数据源的密码；生产环境应通过外部安全配置注入.

properties.name: lavshard.data-sources.*.managed.driver-class-name
properties.description: JDBC 驱动类名；未配置时由 JDBC URL 和驱动实现推断.

properties.name: lavshard.data-sources.*.managed.maximum-pool-size
properties.description: Starter 托管 HikariCP 连接池的最大连接数.

properties.name: lavshard.data-sources.*.managed.minimum-idle
properties.description: Starter 托管 HikariCP 连接池的最小空闲连接数.

properties.name: lavshard.data-sources.*.managed.connection-timeout
properties.description: 从 Starter 托管连接池获取连接的最长等待毫秒数.

properties.name: lavshard.defaults
properties.description: 分片表默认配置，可指定未显式声明布局的表所使用的默认布局.

properties.name: lavshard.defaults.layout
properties.description: 未显式配置表级布局或完整拓扑时使用的默认分片布局名称.

properties.name: lavshard.layouts
properties.description: 可复用分片布局模板；启动时展开为完整、稳定且不可变的物理拓扑.

properties.name: lavshard.layouts.*.version
properties.description: 布局的稳定版本；参与生成规则版本和拓扑版本，禁止使用时间戳或随机值.

properties.name: lavshard.layouts.*.data-source-ids
properties.description: 参与布局的数据源 ID 有序列表；列表顺序属于持久化数据定位契约.

properties.name: lavshard.layouts.*.tables-per-data-source
properties.description: 每个物理数据源包含的分片表数量；关闭表后缀时必须为 1.

properties.name: lavshard.layouts.*.bucket-count
properties.description: 固定逻辑桶数量；必须大于等于布局生成的物理节点数量.

properties.name: lavshard.layouts.*.algorithm.name
properties.description: 布局使用的分片算法注册名.

properties.name: lavshard.layouts.*.algorithm.hash-version
properties.description: 布局使用的稳定 Hash 语义版本.

properties.name: lavshard.layouts.*.table-suffix.enabled
properties.description: 是否为逻辑表名追加数字后缀；纯分库同名表模式应关闭.

properties.name: lavshard.layouts.*.table-suffix.separator
properties.description: 逻辑表名与数字后缀之间的分隔符.

properties.name: lavshard.layouts.*.table-suffix.start
properties.description: 第一个物理表数字后缀的起始编号.

properties.name: lavshard.layouts.*.table-suffix.width
properties.description: 数字后缀的最小补零宽度.

properties.name: lavshard.layouts.*.placement-strategy
properties.description: 布局首次展开时使用的逻辑桶放置策略.

properties.name: lavshard.tables
properties.description: 逻辑分片表配置；可以引用布局模板，也可以声明完整显式拓扑.

properties.name: lavshard.tables.*.rule-version
properties.description: 专家模式下显式指定的稳定规则版本；布局模式自动生成.

properties.name: lavshard.tables.*.sharding-column
properties.description: 逻辑表的分片列名称.

properties.name: lavshard.tables.*.layout
properties.description: 表级布局名称；未配置时继承 lavshard.defaults.layout.

properties.name: lavshard.tables.*.algorithm.name
properties.description: 专家模式下显式指定的分片算法注册名.

properties.name: lavshard.tables.*.algorithm.hash-version
properties.description: 专家模式下显式指定的稳定 Hash 语义版本.

properties.name: lavshard.tables.*.topology.version
properties.description: 专家模式下显式指定的稳定拓扑版本.

properties.name: lavshard.tables.*.topology.bucket-count
properties.description: 专家模式下显式指定的固定逻辑桶数量.

properties.name: lavshard.tables.*.topology.bucket-placements
properties.description: 专家模式下逻辑桶 ID 到稳定物理节点 ID 的完整映射.

properties.name: lavshard.tables.*.topology.nodes
properties.description: 专家模式下物理节点 ID 到数据源和物理表的映射.
